entry.note: Jing-Liu Iwahori-Hecke characters type A. DIRECT fit with QOU chi-character content. Cited in q-hecke-seminormal-character-closure.ts (cites array).

relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from the arXiv title page (arXiv:2104.06067v1, math.QA), which matches the subject and identifier of the seeded entry. CITATION STATUS: exactly ONE site, and it is manifest-level only - mass-endomorphism/q-hecke-seminormal-character-closure.ts:50 cites[]. The sibling .md never cites it in prose (greps for the key, for the author surnames, for 'vertex operator' and for 'Halverson' in that .md return nothing; its only Murnaghan-Nakayama sentence is about a bug in the corpus's own producer, not about this paper). So the citation is NOT load-bearing: the block's actual claim - that the recursive Markov-axiom ascent agrees with the partition-sum Wedderburn form - is not supplied by this document. It is nonetheless an apt background reference, because the block's .md turns precisely on the distinction between the classical Murnaghan-Nakayama character chi^lambda_MN and the q-Hecke character chi^lambda_q, which is this paper's subject, and it carries explicit closed forms the folio's chi^lambda_q producer could be checked against.

keyResults.statement: Closed formula for the irreducible Iwahori-Hecke character chi^lambda labelled by a HOOK partition, for any mu |- n.
keyResults.useForFolio: Independent closed form to cross-check computations/tr_m_q_hecke_seminormal.py and the Hoefsmit chi^lambda_q values on hook irreps.

keyResults.statement: Closed formula for the irreducible Hecke characters labelled by TWO-ROW partitions.
keyResults.useForFolio: Second independent cross-check family for the same chi^lambda_q compute (n>=4 two-row blocks).

keyResults.statement: Determinant-type Murnaghan-Nakayama rule for Hecke characters (dual/vertex-operator derivation), reproving Ram's combinatorial MN formula.
keyResults.useForFolio: The precise literature statement separating chi^lambda_q from the classical chi^lambda_MN - the distinction the block's .md says was previously mis-implemented.

proposedActions.rationale: jing-liu-2021 is cited only in the .ts cites[] and none of its results is used. Its hook (Thm 2.9) and two-row (Thm 2.11) closed forms give a parameter-free external cross-check of the chi^lambda_q values the block's producer computes, which would make the citation load-bearing instead of decorative.
If the cross-check lands, cite the specific locator (Thm 2.9 / 2.11 / 3.1) in the .md prose rather than leaving a bare cites[] entry.
